summary: Vancouver, WA resident, former MIT student (dropped out), experienced in defense contracting and technology startups, has worked in Iraq and Afghanistan since 2003, libertarian atheist, strong interest in entrepreneurship and technology, particularly in cloud computing and virtualization, has a background in medical software (PACS/RIS), firearms enthusiast, enjoys SCUBA diving, interested in cooking and molecular gastronomy, has a preference for remote work and flexible environments, values transparency in compensation and company operations, has experience with various tech communities and hacker spaces, has a strong opinion on immigration and tax policies, and is critical of government inefficiencies.
